corrections.text: The article says Socket's post could be read "only through a summarizing tool" and that it "dates the injections to October 7 and 8". The full Socket page was in fact captured and read directly during editorial review. Socket dates its analyzed burst of 346 repositories to October 8; October 7 appears only in its update about more than 500 accounts, which it says committed the workflow to tens of thousands of repositories since October 7.
